ayahs.ar: هَلۡ اَتٰي عَلَي الۡاِنۡسَانِ حِيۡنٌ مِّنَ الدَّهۡرِ لَمۡ يَكُنۡ شَيۡـًٔا مَّذۡكُوۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Hal ataa 'alal insaani heenum minad dahri lam yakun shai'am mazkooraa
ayahs.en: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا خَلَقۡنَا الۡاِنۡسَانَ مِنۡ نُّطۡفَةٍ اَمۡشَاجٍࣗۖ نَّبۡتَلِيۡهِ فَجَعَلۡنٰهُ سَمِيۡعًاۭ بَصِيۡرًاۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Innaa khalaqnal insaana min nutfatin amshaajin nabta leehi faja'alnaahu samee'am baseeraa
ayahs.en: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا هَدَيۡنٰهُ السَّبِيۡلَ اِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَّاِمَّا كَفُوۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Innaa hadainaahus sabeela immaa shaakiranw wa immaa kafoora
ayahs.en: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا٘ اَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ سَلٰسِلَا۠ وَاَغۡلٰلًا وَّسَعِيۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Innaaa a'tadnaa lilkaa fireena salaasila wa aghlaalanw wa sa'eeraa
ayahs.en: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الۡاَبۡرَارَ يَشۡرَبُوۡنَ مِنۡ كَاۡسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُوۡرًاۚ‏
ayahs.tl: innal abraara yashra boona min kaasin kaana mizaa juhaa kaafooraa
ayahs.en: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kafur,

ayahs.ar: عَيۡنًا يَّشۡرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ اللّٰهِ يُفَجِّرُوۡنَهَا تَفۡجِيۡرًا
ayahs.tl: 'Aynany yashrabu bihaa 'ibaadul laahi yafajjiroonahaa tafjeeraa
ayahs.en: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allah will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].

ayahs.ar: يُوۡفُوۡنَ بِالنَّذۡرِ وَيَخَافُوۡنَ يَوۡمًا كَانَ شَرُّهٗ مُسۡتَطِيۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Yoofoona binnazri wa yakhaafoona yawman kaana sharruhoo mustateeraa
ayahs.en: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.

ayahs.ar: وَيُطۡعِمُوۡنَ الطَّعَامَ عَلٰي حُبِّهٖ مِسۡكِيۡنًا وَّيَتِيۡمًا وَّاَسِيۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Wa yut''imoonat ta'aama 'alaa hubbihee miskeenanw wa yatemanw wa aseeraa
ayahs.en: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,

ayahs.ar: اِنَّمَا نُطۡعِمُكُمۡ لِوَجۡهِ اللّٰهِ لَا نُرِيۡدُ مِنۡكُمۡ جَزَآءً وَّلَا شُكُوۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Innaamaa nut'imukum li wajhil laahi laa nureedu minkum jazaaa'anw wa laa shukooraa
ayahs.en: [Saying], "We feed you only for the countenance of Allah. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا نَخَافُ مِنۡ رَّبِّنَا يَوۡمًا عَبُوۡسًا قَمۡطَرِيۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Innaa nakhaafu mir Rabbinna Yawman 'aboosan qamtareeraa
ayahs.en: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."

ayahs.ar: فَوَقٰىهُمُ اللّٰهُ شَرَّ ذٰلِكَ الۡيَوۡمِ وَلَقّٰىهُمۡ نَضۡرَةً وَّسُرُوۡرًاۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa waqaahumul laahu sharra zaalikal yawmi wa laqqaahum nadratanw wa surooraa
ayahs.en: So Allah will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness

ayahs.ar: وَجَزٰىهُمۡ بِمَا صَبَرُوۡا جَنَّةً وَّحَرِيۡرًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa jazaahum bimaa sabaroo janatanw wa hareeraa
ayahs.en: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].

ayahs.ar: مُّتَّكِـِٕيۡنَ فِيۡهَا عَلَي الۡاَرَآئِكِۚ لَا يَرَوۡنَ فِيۡهَا شَمۡسًا وَّلَا زَمۡهَرِيۡرًاۚ‏
ayahs.tl: muttaki'eena feeha 'alal araaa 'iki laa yarawna feehaa shamsanw wa laa zamhareeraa
ayahs.en: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.

ayahs.ar: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيۡهِمۡ ظِلٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتۡ قُطُوۡفُهَا تَذۡلِيۡلًا
ayahs.tl: Wa daaniyatan 'alaihim zilaaluhaa wa zullilat qutoofu haa tazleela
ayahs.en: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.

ayahs.ar: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ بِاٰنِيَةٍ مِّنۡ فِضَّةٍ وَّاَكۡوَابٍ كَانَتۡ قَوَارِيۡرَا۠ۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa yutaafu 'alaihim bi aaniyatim min fiddatinw wa akwaabin kaanat qawaareeraa
ayahs.en: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],

ayahs.ar: قَوَارِيۡرَا۠ مِنۡ فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوۡهَا تَقۡدِيۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Qawaareera min fiddatin qaddaroohaa taqdeeraa
ayahs.en: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.

ayahs.ar: وَيُسۡقَوۡنَ فِيۡهَا كَاۡسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنۡجَبِيۡلًاۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa yusawna feehaa kaasan kaana mizaajuhaa zanjabeelaa
ayahs.en: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger

ayahs.ar: عَيۡنًا فِيۡهَا تُسَمّٰي سَلۡسَبِيۡلًا
ayahs.tl: 'Aynan feeha tusammaa salsabeelaa
ayahs.en: [From] a fountain within Paradise named Salsabeel.

ayahs.ar: وَيَطُوۡفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وِلۡدَانٌ مُّخَلَّدُوۡنَۚ اِذَا رَاَيۡتَهُمۡ حَسِبۡتَهُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤًا مَّنۡثُوۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Wa yatoofu 'alaihim wildaanum mukhalladoona izaa ra aytahum hasibtahum lu'lu 'am mansoora
ayahs.en: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا رَاَيۡتَ ثَمَّ رَاَيۡتَ نَعِيۡمًا وَّمُلۡكًا كَبِيۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa ra ayta summa ra ayta na'eemanw wa mulkan kabeera
ayahs.en: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.

ayahs.ar: عٰلِيَهُمۡ ثِيَابُ سُنۡدُسٍ خُضۡرٌ وَّاِسۡتَبۡرَقٌؗ وَّحُلُّوۡ٘ا اَسَاوِرَ مِنۡ فِضَّةٍۚ وَسَقٰىهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ شَرَابًا طَهُوۡرًا
ayahs.tl: 'Aaliyahum siyaabu sundusin khudrunw wa istabraq, wa hullooo asaawira min fiddatinw wa saqaahum Rabbuhum sharaaban tahooraa
ayahs.en: Upon the inhabitants will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ هٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمۡ جَزَآءً وَّكَانَ سَعۡيُكُمۡ مَّشۡكُوۡرًاࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Innaa haazaa kaana lakum jazz 'anw wa kaana sa'yukum mashkooraa
ayahs.en: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ الۡقُرۡاٰنَ تَنۡزِيۡلًاۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Innaa nahnu nazzalnaa 'alaikal quraana tanzeelaa
ayahs.en: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Qur'an progressively.

ayahs.ar: فَاصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعۡ مِنۡهُمۡ اٰثِمًا اَوۡ كَفُوۡرًاۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Fasbir lihukmi Rabbika wa laa tuti' minhum aasiman aw kafooraa
ayahs.en: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].

ayahs.ar: وَاذۡكُرِ اسۡمَ رَبِّكَ بُكۡرَةً وَّاَصِيۡلًاۖۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wazkuris ma Rabbika bukratanw wa aseelaa
ayahs.en: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening

ayahs.ar: وَمِنَ الَّيۡلِ فَاسۡجُدۡ لَهٗ وَسَبِّحۡهُ لَيۡلًا طَوِيۡلًا
ayahs.tl: Wa minal laili fasjud lahoo wa sabbihhu lailan taweelaa
ayahs.en: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt Him a long [part of the] night.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّوۡنَ الۡعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُوۡنَ وَرَآءَهُمۡ يَوۡمًا ثَقِيۡلًا
ayahs.tl: Inna haaa'ulaa'i yuhibboona 'aajilata wa yazaroona waraaa'ahum yawman saqeelaa
ayahs.en: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.

ayahs.ar: نَحۡنُ خَلَقۡنٰهُمۡ وَشَدَدۡنَا٘ اَسۡرَهُمۡۚ وَاِذَا شِئۡنَا بَدَّلۡنَا٘ اَمۡثَالَهُمۡ تَبۡدِيۡلًا
ayahs.tl: Nahnu khalaqnaahum wa shadadnaaa asrahum wa izaa shi'naa baddalnaaa amsaala hum tabdeelaa
ayahs.en: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ هٰذِهٖ تَذۡكِرَةٌۚ فَمَنۡ شَآءَ اتَّخَذَ اِلٰي رَبِّهٖ سَبِيۡلًا
ayahs.tl: Inna haazihee tazkiratun fa man shaaa'at takhaza ilaa rabbihee sabeela
ayahs.en: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا تَشَآءُوۡنَ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ يَّشَآءَ اللّٰهُؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ كَانَ عَلِيۡمًا حَكِيۡمًاࣗۙۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa maa tashaaa'oona illaa anyyashaaa'al laah; innal laahaa kaana'Aleeman Hakeema
ayahs.en: And you do not will except that Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.

ayahs.ar: يُّدۡخِلُ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ فِيۡ رَحۡمَتِهٖؕ وَالظّٰلِمِيۡنَ اَعَدَّ لَهُمۡ عَذَابًا اَلِيۡمًاࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Yudkhilu mai yashaaa'u fee rahmatih; wazzaalimeena a'adda lahum 'azaaban aleemaa
ayahs.en: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
